cases.copilotQuestion: 按项目和账期汇总月对账折后实收金额

copilotQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(m.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", REPLACE(COALESCE(m.year_and_month, CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'))), '-', '') AS "accountPeriod", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.folding_after_total_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 2) AS "amount" FROM public.ods_ptr_mysql_a_month_accounting m WHERE m.status > 1 GROUP BY CAST(m.project_id AS VARCHAR), REPLACE(COALESCE(m.year_and_month, CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'))), '-', '')

oracleQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(m.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", REPLACE(COALESCE(m.year_and_month, CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'))), '-', '') AS "accountPeriod", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(m.folding_after_total_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 2) AS "amount" FROM public.ods_ptr_mysql_a_month_accounting m WHERE m.status > 1 GROUP BY CAST(m.project_id AS VARCHAR), REPLACE(COALESCE(m.year_and_month, CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'))), '-', '')

cases.notes: F2-T02 离线黄金 SQL 样本；真实 L2 汇总基准仍待接 adminapi 端点或财务签字 SQL。

cases.copilotQuestion: 按项目和账期汇总售账应收金额

copilotQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(b.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", date_format(CAST(COALESCE(b.finish_time, b.apply_time) AS timestamp), '%Y%m') AS "accountPeriod", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(a.receivable_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 2) AS "amount" FROM public.ods_ptr_mysql_a_sale_account a JOIN public.ods_ptr_mysql_t_flower_biz_info b ON CAST(a.biz_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(b.id AS VARCHAR) WHERE b.biz_type IN (5, 6, 7) GROUP BY CAST(b.project_id AS VARCHAR), date_format(CAST(COALESCE(b.finish_time, b.apply_time) AS timestamp), '%Y%m')

oracleQuery.nativeSql: SELECT CAST(b.project_id AS VARCHAR) AS "projectId", date_format(CAST(COALESCE(b.finish_time, b.apply_time) AS timestamp), '%Y%m') AS "accountPeriod", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(a.receivable_amount AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 2) AS "amount" FROM public.ods_ptr_mysql_a_sale_account a JOIN public.ods_ptr_mysql_t_flower_biz_info b ON CAST(a.biz_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(b.id AS VARCHAR) WHERE b.biz_type IN (5, 6, 7) GROUP BY CAST(b.project_id AS VARCHAR), date_format(CAST(COALESCE(b.finish_time, b.apply_time) AS timestamp), '%Y%m')

cases.notes: 售/赠/坏链与租摆链分离汇总，禁止与月对账 SUM 混合。
